Record Class AttentionContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.llm.attention.AttentionContext
Record Components:
scale - attention scale; <= 0 means kernel default (1/sqrt(D)).
dropout - dropout probability (torch_native only; usually 0 at inference).
isCausal - whether to apply causal masking when mask is null.
numQoHeads - query / output head count (GQA).
numKvHeads - key / value head count.
headDim - per-head dimension.
layerId - KV pool layer index (FlashInfer).
startPos - write position in the request (FlashInfer); uniform when startPositions is null.
seqLen - query sequence length this step.
cacheLen - total cached length after this step (startPos + seqLen) when cacheLens is null.
kvPool - shared pool, or null for contiguous torch_native-only calls.
kvMetadata - CSR page table for FlashInfer, or null.
workspace - FlashInfer workspace, or null.
startPositions - optional per-row write positions (decode); null = uniform.
cacheLens - optional per-row cache lengths (decode); null = uniform.
raggedIndptr - cumulative segment lengths for ragged contiguous prefill; null otherwise.
public record AttentionContext(double scale, double dropout, boolean isCausal, int numQoHeads, int numKvHeads, int headDim, int layerId, int startPos, int seqLen, int cacheLen, KvCachePool kvPool, FlashInferKvMetadata kvMetadata, FlashInferWorkspace workspace, int[] startPositions, int[] cacheLens, int[] raggedIndptr) extends Record
Per-call metadata for AttentionKernel.forward(Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, AttentionContext).
